description.value:
Requirements You are broadcasting the Numbers Frequency

Traits Signal

Against a creature that has already failed a saving throw against one of your effects this encounter, the status penalty to Will from Numbers is −2 instead of −1. This is the same penalty at a larger value, not an additional one. The condition persists for the rest of the encounter once met, even if the creature later succeeds at a save.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB4 (there is no base −1 penalty encoded anywhere to scale) plus a "has this target already failed a save against me this encounter" history predicate, which was not found in the roll-option/predicate vocabulary reviewed this session.
